versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.1 of the Skincare skill introduces no functional or content changes.

- No file changes detected since the previous version.
- All features, descriptions, and guidance remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the Skincare skill with AI-based skin analysis, ingredient curation, medical beauty education, and personalized care plans.
- Supports filtering by distance, popularity, and price tier for professional skincare services.
- Provides real-time queue updates, reservation channels, business hour changes, navigation, community photos, and tips.
- Sample requests and use guidelines included for easy usage.
- Content adapts dynamically based on geographic and trending data.
